method: Live browser, action handler to second requestAnimationFrame; warm server connection. Diagnostic harness pauses further pagination after measured frame.
fixed_issue: Switching from a deeply scrolled large list to a small cached section could render zero document rows. Cached scroll positions are now restored per list, and virtual scroll is clamped to the actual row count.
limits: This is a bounded smoke test, not an hours-long memory soak or complete download of every document. JS heap readings are Chromium estimates. Reports and catalogs outside Universal Journal are not covered.
